text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED - ID INC-2024-2391. Severity: P1. Trigger: production SLO breach for TextGen latency. First alert at 09:03 UTC.

Amelia: seeing a tail-latency spike on /v1/generate since the 08:55 deploy. P95 ok but P99 and timeouts for long inputs.

Raj: confirmed. Canary metrics looked fine — sampling missed long-sequence traffic. Impacting paid customers on dedicated clusters.

Eoin: paged. I'm oncall, taking lead. Quick triage: is rollback automated?

deploy-bot: Automated rollback attempted at 09:10 but drain failed for 2/6 pods: error draining connection: preStop hook hung.

Amelia: aha, the deploy added a new prefetch daemon that blocks graceful shutdown for certain KV-cache sizes. That explains failed drains.

Sylvia: product note — subset of customers sending sequences >2048 tokens. Temporary mitigation: can we gate through a feature-flag to reject long requests with 429 and clear backlog?

Eoin: good idea. I'll coordinate flag flip. Which flag?

Amelia: flag key is feature.limits.long_input_protect (prod). Use admin console or flags CLI.

Eoin: flipping flag now -> SupportBot, prepare canned message for customer-facing comms if we need to throttle.

SupportBot: Draft created: "We're throttling exceptionally long requests to protect latency for all customers while we remediate a regression in a recent model runtime change." Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/INC-2391/comm.

Eoin: flag flip done at 09:18. Confirmed ~90% of long requests got 429s. Immediate P99 dropped but some in-flight still lingering.

Amelia: since automated rollback couldn't drain, we have two options: force-terminate pods (risk in-flight errors) or patch preStop to be no-op and reattempt rollback. Prefer patch+graceful.

Raj: I'll push a tiny config patch to remove the blocking prefetch hook. Command:```kubectl patch deployment/redwood-serving -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"preStopOverride":"true"}}}}}'``` will set the override env var. Then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/redwood-serving`.

Eoin: execute when ready. Coordinate with deploy-bot to re-run rollback after restart.

deploy-bot: acknowledged. Will re-run automated rollback once pods report Ready.

Raj: patch applied at 09:25 and restarted. New pods coming up. Monitoring readiness.

Amelia: spinning up blackbox SLO probes to verify tail latency for long sequences. Script hits /v1/generate with 3 sequence lengths [512, 1024, 3072] every 10s. Logs to /ops/slo-probes/INC-2391.

Eoin: can we also run a small canary that sends the exact customer payloads that failed earlier? We have a stored sample in /incidents/samples/2391/long-input.json.

Sylvia: please do, but mask any PII. I'm coordinating customer notifications if we need to extend throttling.

Amelia: blackbox probes show P99 back to baseline for 512/1024. 3072 still sees occasional spikes but much improved after restart. No new 504s for last 6 minutes.

deploy-bot: automated rollback attempt #2 triggered at 09:33. Drain succeeded. Old revision fully rolled back at 09:36.

Eoin: nice. Confirming traffic metrics: routing shifted, errors down, unit cost normalized.

SupportBot: updating status page: "Mitigation in progress: traffic throttling for long inputs; rollback completed; monitoring."

Sylvia: check customer impact window and list affected tenants — Support, pull sales/comms list and tag top 5.

SupportBot: top 5 customers affected: AcmeAI, NovaScribe, BeaconRetail, DataForge, LumenHealth. Draft sent to account teams.

Amelia: post-rollback verification: keep blackbox probes for 60m, add synthetic spike test at t+30m. Also collect kv-cache metrics and preStop durations.

Raj: collecting logs and will snapshot heap and runtime traces at 09:50. I'll open a short-lived debug pod to reproduce locally.

Eoin: handoff: I'll keep monitoring for 1hr then transition to next oncall Raj. If anything regresses, @Amelia escalate to eng-runtime.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED - mitigation applied. Severity downgraded to P2 at 09:42; monitoring.

Sylvia: filing RCA ticket INC-2391-RCA. Initial blameless notes: preStop hook blocking drains + insufficient long-sequence canary coverage.

Amelia: TL;DR runbook actions: 1) revert prefetch preStop behavior (done), 2) expand canary test matrix to include >2048 tokens (action item), 3) ensure automated rollback drains tolerate stuck preStop (action item).

Eoin: closing logistics: I will post a short incident blurb in #general after RCAs are linked. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

SupportBot: Final status update scheduled at 10:45 UTC.

Amelia: leaving the thread but monitoring logs, reachable on pager.

Eoin: last check at 09:48 — all green. moving to watch.
_meta: Slack thread exported for incident coordination and post-incident ingestion
